title: CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies
abstract: arXiv:2609.32192v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. translated_title: CoMemBench：跨多智能体工作流拓扑的协作记忆边界基准测试
translated_abstract: 多智能体工作流要求在与任务相关的智能体之间共享信息，而无关的、过时的、未经验证的或不兼容的信息则必须保持隔离。我们将这种以任务为条件的信息范围称为“协作记忆边界”。工作流拓扑决定了哪些中间产物适用于哪些下游工作节点，以及它们何时失效，从而为共享与隔离提供了一个结构性的压力维度。现有的记忆基准主要评估信息的保留与检索能力，而多智能体基准则侧重于协调与端到端任务完成，导致以拓扑为条件的记忆边界在很大程度上未被测量。我们提出CoMemBench，一个基于实际执行的基准测试，用于衡量多智能体工作流拓扑中的协作记忆共享与隔离。该基准从基于来源的依赖图出发，在四个领域构建了800个复合工作流，并包含节点局部的特定规范……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CoMemBench，一个基于实际执行的基准测试，通过四个领域共800个复合工作流，首次系统测量多智能体工作流拓扑下协作记忆的共享与隔离边界，填补了现有记忆基准与多智能体基准之间的评测空白。
en_tdlr: CoMemBench is an execution-grounded benchmark that, through 800 composite workflows across four domains, for the first time systematically measures collaborative memory sharing and isolation boundaries conditioned on multi-agent workflow topologies.
